kills.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` so the deposit never updates the balance.

kills.change_summary: Invert the guard to 'require(intitalized);' so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and only succeeds after Initialized(), changing when MinSum is set.

kills.property: After SetMinSum(_ms) on an uninitialized contract, MinSum must remain exactly _ms.
